inputs.prompt: Animate this exact hand-drawn Japanese 2D anime frame. Preserve the image style in EVERY frame: clean black ink contours, flat matte skin, sharp two-tone cel shadows, broad orange hair locks with flat highlight bands, drawn lace and orange flower embroidery, painted blue gothic cathedral background. Maintain exactly the same face, amber eyes, copper-orange hair, orange flower, ivory veil, cream dress, black collar ribbon, wrist chains, wooden cross, camera tilt and composition. Do not turn into 3D or realistic rendering. No shiny plastic skin, no strand-by-strand hair, no volumetric gradient shading. Chains and wrists remain secured and fixed. No camera movement, no cuts, no extra figures, no subtitles, no fire. Only subtle drawn breathing, hair and veil motion. The young adult woman is already worried and exhausted from her earlier warning. She softens her brows, looks slightly downward toward the offscreen priest, and quietly pleads once, 'お父様……その子を逃がして。' Address him, pause briefly, then finish the plea and close her lips. Restrained concern, no renewed shouting, no repeated forward struggle, no smile. Subtle natural mouth shapes, a small breath and moist eyes; end with a brief attentive look.
